notes:
- Voxel zombies and voxel first-person hands are back (they look better and are easier to get right).
  The guns stay realistic, and so do the scanned world materials and props. The download is much smaller.
- Male and female look clearly different: female survivors are shorter and slimmer, with narrow
  shoulders, slim arms and legs, eyelashes and fine brows. Male survivors are taller and broader, with
  heavy brows and stubble. Same outfits and gear, nothing exaggerated. Female first-person hands are
  smaller and slimmer.
- New customization: HAIR and HAIR COLOUR (replaces the armband, which is now always your team colour):
  Short, Buzz Cut, Long, Ponytail, Bob, Bun, Curly, Braid, Mohawk and Shaved, in 10 colours (dyed ones unlock
  with levels). Default hair is short for male and a ponytail for female.
- P-12: camos now work on it, and the Extended Mag sticks out of the bottom of the grip instead of
  through the gun.
- Launcher: it now updates itself. Versions compare as decimals, so 0.255 comes before 0.26.
